fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. Reproduced: rhiza change show 01M6WMCCRC0KSCWEV17VY8KVQP fails on evidence op 01M6X6KYJY5EPC5BJT5R4EEBB6, whose statement holds both an @{ID} text reference and '<branch>'. Cause: model.ShowFieldValue (internal/model/textshow.go) re-encodes a referenced text with json.Marshal, which HTML-escapes < > & and always escapes U+2028/U+2029; op.Encode then rejects the shown op as not canonical. The helper also feeds change show's indexed path, change diff, show, slice and render. One question went to the arbiter (fix shape); it ruled to encode with canon.Marshal in the shared helper, keep op.Encode's check strict, and cover it with a unit test and a change show testscript. The change set serves milestone-25 (backlog and bugs), as the sibling ship-change fix does.
fields.title: Plan: fix rhiza change show on canonical text (autonomous)
